headline_marked: New transport committee to [[end road extortion and mafia culture]]
headline: New transport committee to end road extortion and mafia culture
summary: BNP Acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi believes the newly formed Road Transport Workers Federation will reorganize the sector.
details: BNP Acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi expressed hope that the newly formed Road Transport Workers Federation committee will control illegal activities and extortion on the roads.
He stated that this committee would bring an end to the 'mafia culture' that has long plagued the transport sector.
Speaking to journalists on Thursday morning, Rizvi was accompanied by members of the new committee led by BNP leader Nazim Uddin after paying tribute at the graves of Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia.
Rizvi emphasized that the transport sector would be overhauled with new ideas to end long-standing stagnation and ensure legal operations.
The goal is to set a new standard for passenger services and eliminate the chaos that has persisted for 17 years.
He added that political stability and responsible leadership are essential to ending the anarchy in the sector.
caption:
Can a new committee finally end the 'mafia culture' and road extortion in Bangladesh?

BNP Acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi expressed hope that the newly formed Road Transport Workers Federation committee will control illegal activities and extortion on the roads.

He stated that this committee would bring an end to the 'mafia culture' that has long plagued the transport sector.

Speaking to journalists on Thursday morning, Rizvi was accompanied by members of the new committee led by BNP leader Nazim Uddin after paying tribute at the graves of Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia.

Rizvi emphasized that the transport sector would be overhauled with new ideas to end long-standing stagnation and ensure legal operations.

The goal is to set a new standard for passenger services and eliminate the chaos that has persisted for 17 years.

He added that political stability and responsible leadership are essential to ending the anarchy in the sector.

#Bangladesh #Transport #BNP #RoadSafety #PublicService

Source: Jamuna TV
